notes.title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT
notes.content:
THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT
We've been working on the game for quite some time. Now that it's out, we're especially grateful for your support and kind words!
Unfortunately, we don't get much feedback.ː2016imnotcryingː
It would helped us a lot if you made a review, where you indicated everything that you liked and what caused difficulties. It would also be very helpful in resolving any issues you may have.

Best regards, 
Shrine of Tails teamː2016villainː
